Which peaks can act as the internal reference

dot-reference_peak_ok.Rd

Which peaks can act as the internal reference

Usage

.reference_peak_ok(
  peaks,
  min_score = .get_moosaic_option("min_match_factor"),
  min_area_percent = 0.001
)

Arguments

peaks

Tibble with name, score, area, the halogen/heteroatom count columns (F, Cl, Br, I, B, P, Si) and optionally a logical combined_peak.

min_score

Minimum library match factor; defaults to option moosaic.min_match_factor.

min_area_percent

Minimum share of the total area (percent).

Value

Logical vector: named, sufficiently well matched, not combined, free of disqualifying elements and large enough.
